landing.headline: Order from the table — no queue at the counter.
landing.lead: Servio puts menu, orders and service on each table QR: faster for guests, clearer for kitchen and staff.
landing.howLead: From QR to delivery, live end to end.
landing.step1Text: Guests scan the QR at their table, sunbed or counter.
landing.step2Text: They pick items, add notes and send the order in a few taps.
landing.step3Text: Kitchen prepares, waiters deliver, status updates in real time.
landing.forTitle: Built for restaurants, bars and pizzerias
landing.forLead: Less waiting, fewer mistakes, higher average ticket — for any table-service venue.
landing.benefit1: Multilingual menu (IT, EN, EL, DE) with instant price updates
landing.benefit2: Separate queues for kitchen/bar and waiters
landing.benefit3: Call a waiter from the guest’s spot
landing.benefit4: Unique QR per table or spot and white-label branding
landing.finalLead: Open the demo or sign in as staff to see kitchen, deliveries and admin.
